scope: Current official PostNL assignment products, API and public data terms plus the corrected current CBS/Esri PC6 release and PDOK OGC service were audited without contacting a provider, registering, authenticating, purchasing a table, accepting terms or a contract, querying protected address/building/cadastral/land data, or creating a repository or publication destination.

countryIdentity.rule: The Netherlands retains ISO NL and its registered territory. PostNL assignment, CBS/Esri derived PC6 geometry, BAG address/building identity, administrative/statistical/cadastral context and AGID containment remain separate authorities and grains.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete rights-cleared PostNL PC6 assignment and exception denominator, including house-number ranges, P.O. box ranges, NAPO, organizations, reply/freepost, facility/special/non-geographic and historical or transition classes, is reconciled to the corrected current CBS/Esri derived PC6 Polygon/MultiPolygon release. Edition, effective date, dataset-specific terms, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, coverage, exclusions and reproducible transformation are pinned in an approved immutable artifact. The real NL API/app must normalize NNNN AA, fit and render a translucent area with a clear outline, and show selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual classification, source, reference date and confidence. CBS/Esri surfaces remain derived and never establish PostNL assignment or deliverability. PostNL site/API observations, BAG points/buildings, PC4/PC5, statistical/admin/cadastral units, buffers, hulls, Voronoi/raster cells and synthetic fixtures never satisfy M2 by themselves; non-areal endpoints remain non-area.

officialObservations.finding: CBS records that the PC5/PC6 2025 publication released 9 July 2026 had a postcode-linkage error and was corrected 18 August 2026. The newest publication covers reference date 1 January 2025 as v1, supplies GeoPackage and Excel downloads and says the files contain all postcodes regardless of statistical suppression.

The fixed ZIP is 192,553,634 bytes. Its 626,851,840-byte GeoPackage has 465,935 unique valid PC6 MultiPolygons in EPSG:28992; its workbook is 54,083,618 bytes. ZIP, GeoPackage and workbook hashes are pinned below.

CBS states that Esri Nederland derives PC4, PC5 and PC6 postcode surfaces from BAG addresses, that postcode areas change over time and are full-covering, and that distribution is permitted under CC BY 4.0 NL. These are derived statistical display surfaces, not PostNL boundaries.
CBS permits use without charge, retains rights, requires source attribution and requires © CBS, © ESRI Nederland for postcode boundary or data visualization.

The unauthenticated CC BY 4.0 service exposes one postcode6 MultiPolygon collection, but its current description reaches reporting year 2024 and the default sample is 2015. It was not substituted for the newer corrected 2025 artifact.

PostNL sells the current table, offers house-number or range level, supplies weekly or monthly updates and provides the files only after request through a protected IT environment. No public AGID processing, serving or redistribution grant is published.

PCT-R contains current postcode information for all house-number and P.O.-box ranges; PCT-H contains about nine million addresses. PCT-R distinguishes H house numbers, B P.O. boxes and N NAPO ranges and supplies point coordinates, not postcode polygons.
The endpoint requires an apikey and a house number. It returns address fields, match scores and latitude/longitude, with no postcode Polygon or MultiPolygon.

PostNL site data may be used only personally or strictly internally. Copyright/database rights remain with PostNL or suppliers; trading, reproduction or third-party availability are prohibited, as is a direct data gateway without prior written permission.
Use requires an API account, is limited to the customer's own webshop/internal workflow and may not be supplied to third parties or used to build/exploit a database.

reproducibility.method: Verify twelve exact file lengths and SHA-256 values; confirm the current CBS correction, all-postcodes and rights notices; parse PDOK service, collection, schema and sample; then use read-only GDAL/SQLite full-layer queries for PC6 uniqueness, format, geometry type, CRS, extent, emptiness, validity, polygon parts, positions and public ordinary/P.O.-box examples.

dataQuality.risk: The open CBS/Esri surfaces are valid current derived geometry but do not establish PostNL assignment. The complete ordinary-plus-exception operator denominator is contract/protected data, public serving rights are not established, and at least the current public P.O.-box code 2500 GG has no CBS surface.

browserReview.reason: No approved complete PostNL assignment plus corrected CBS runtime artifact exists to exercise. A browser scene was not staged with one CBS surface, a PO-box proxy, BAG geometry or synthetic data.

reportPresentation.reason: The exact audit table communicates the decisive 465,935-valid-derived-surfaces versus missing-authorized-assignment-denominator result more accurately than a chart.

blockerSummary: The corrected 2025 CBS/Esri release provides 465,935 unique valid rights-cleared derived PC6 MultiPolygons, but it is not PostNL assignment authority and omits at least the current public P.O.-box code 2500 GG. The complete PostNL PCT-R/PCT-H ordinary and H/B/N exception denominator is sold through a protected environment; public data terms prohibit reproduction and third-party availability, and no AGID public-serving grant was established. No approved immutable NL runtime artifact or real NL API/application visualization can therefore pass without unauthorized use or false area semantics.
unblockConditions: Obtain a reviewed PostNL agreement expressly permitting AGID processing, reconciliation, derived linkage and public serving, or a separately open complete current PC6 assignment release covering every ordinary, P.O.-box, NAPO, organization, reply/freepost, facility, special/non-geographic and historical/transition class.
Reconcile the complete operator denominator to the corrected CBS/Esri release, preserve every non-area exception and keep all surfaces labelled derived rather than official PostNL geometry.

Pin edition, effective date, terms, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, coverage, exclusions and a deterministic transformation; validate code normalization, geometry validity, topology and territory without BAG, PC4/PC5, administrative/statistical/cadastral, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxies.
Publish an approved immutable artifact and pass real NL loader, API, normalization, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
